method: For every audited LLM call in a case that has untraced tokens (178 calls, 93 of them with untraced tokens; all 178 re-checked under the current code in this update), the evidence package was rebuilt from the stored runs (build_package/judge_package on the run graph, verdict, history, menu and budget at that iteration); re-running critic/audit.py on the stored texts reproduces the stored untraced lists exactly for 178/178 calls. Each token was classified from its context; where a derivation is given, every operand was checked to be in that call's package (at the operand's printed precision, percent strings included) or in the same LLM output, and the formula's value compared with the token.
index_note: index = position in the current untraced_numbers.json; index_in_1531_snapshot = position in the 15:31 snapshot (null for tokens new in the regeneration).
